description: Create a typed UML diagram. The 'type' is a metamodel class name (e.g. 'UMLClassDiagram', 'UMLUseCaseDiagram', 'UMLSequenceDiagram', 'UMLActivityDiagram', 'ERDDiagram'). Unlike generate_diagram (Mermaid), this gives a native empty diagram you can populate via create_element. Requires staruml-mcp-extension to be installed in StarUML. Install from https://github.com/ezrabrilliant/staruml-mcp-extension

parentId.description: Parent element's _id (usually the project or a package)

name: create_diagram
